citation: Hecksteden A, et al. PLoS One 2013;8:e81181
protocol: Exhaustive treadmill test (stepwise lactate phase then ramp to VO2max); fasting blood before, 1 h and 24 h after; the later 4-week training phase is separate
population: 12 healthy untrained adults (8 F, 4 M), 49 +/- 7 y, BMI 29 +/- 4, VO2max 34 +/- 7 mL/kg/min
note: Acute exhaustive-test effect is reported separately from the training effect; values 1 h after only (no during-exercise sampling); middle-aged, overweight, sedentary group.
